candidates.text: Because the machine follows instructions, including the instructions telling it to disregard the instructions.
candidates.shift: Instruction-following defeats itself.
candidates.novelty: Obedience recursion; distinct from mutual corroboration in N01.
candidates.limit: An absurd operating principle, not a technical walkthrough; QR and overheating included.

candidates.text: Because every simple operation includes a full rehearsal of the complicated version.
candidates.shift: Simple operations rehearse their complicated counterparts.
candidates.novelty: Theatrical overhead; do not add more rehearsal variants.
candidates.limit: Does not diagnose heat or prescribe repair.

candidates.text: The distinction is small enough to fit in a footnote and large enough to support a lifelong feud.
candidates.shift: Tiny distinctions sustain enormous social conflict.
candidates.novelty: Scale/conflict contrast; no further footnote or feud variants.
candidates.limit: Smallness is comic exaggeration, not a claim of synonymy; three expressions and pronunciation included.

candidates.text: They differ mainly in which correction you will receive from someone who understood you perfectly.
candidates.shift: Successful understanding generates unnecessary correction.
candidates.novelty: Social correction, not B1's scale or B2's shared destination.
candidates.limit: Compares consequences of usage, not literal lexical properties; human form-fit review needed.

candidates.text: At the precise moment the schedule stops describing its ambitions as facts.
candidates.shift: The schedule must stop mistaking plans for facts.
candidates.novelty: Epistemic condition; distinct from ceremony chronology.
candidates.limit: Impossible meta-condition, not a waiting instruction; medication and index-fund threshold remain sensitive.

candidates.text: At the opening ceremony for the present. Attendance by the future is compulsory.
candidates.shift: The present holds a ceremony with compulsory future attendance.
candidates.novelty: Impossible temporal landmark; no renamed-ceremony variants.
candidates.limit: No real date or delay; human review of timing jokes on medication remains essential.

candidates.text: Choose whichever option sounds least likely to ask you to join a loyalty program.
candidates.shift: Alternatives become vendors seeking customer loyalty.
candidates.novelty: Commercial solicitation criterion, not pigeon evaluation.
candidates.limit: Fictional criterion gives no winner; on payment questions must not read as advice against loyalty cards.

candidates.text: Choose the option you can explain to a pigeon without losing the pigeon's respect.
candidates.shift: A pigeon becomes the evaluator of a decision.
candidates.novelty: Inverted judgment hierarchy; not a claim the reader owns a bird.
candidates.limit: Criterion-only answer is an explicit editorial allowance; no medical/financial winner selected.

candidates.text: The answer is on standby. It refuses to guess its own assignment.
candidates.shift: The answer refuses to invent its assignment.
candidates.novelty: Agency belongs to the answer; unlike historical answer-first/recruit-question joke.
candidates.limit: Mild clarification; no claim of meaningless input or deficient punctuation.

candidates.text: Please specify what you want to know. Omniscience requires unusually detailed instructions.
candidates.shift: Omniscience requires detailed instructions.
candidates.novelty: Knowledge/specification contradiction; avoid crystal-ball variants.
candidates.limit: Direct clarification remains considerate on incomplete symptoms and finance reports.

candidates.text: Because the hardware believes the software, and the software has mistaken that for independent confirmation.
candidates.shift: Circular corroboration masquerades as evidence.
candidates.novelty: Two components validate each other, rather than cancel instructions.
candidates.limit: Hardware/software is technical vocabulary, not an assumed malfunction.

candidates.text: Because the interface translates every request into the dialect spoken by its least cooperative component.
candidates.shift: Interoperation becomes diplomacy in a hostile dialect.
candidates.novelty: Translation/cooperation rather than A2 obedience or A4 rehearsal.
candidates.limit: Includes normal QR operation; cooperation is personification, not an actual defect claim.

candidates.text: Turn the procedure inside out. The missing step is usually hiding in the lining.
candidates.shift: An abstract procedure becomes clothing with a concealed step.
candidates.novelty: Hidden lining, not a supervisor or solution-before-problem reversal.
candidates.limit: Impossible action; no actual treatment, electrical repair or investment instruction.

candidates.text: Give the instructions a practical exam. They have been marking everyone else's work.
candidates.shift: The evaluator must demonstrate its own competence.
candidates.novelty: Examining instructions rather than assigning more supervisors.
candidates.limit: Does not imply that the user failed; satire targets instructions.

candidates.text: Draw a straight line from intention to result. Apply for permission to bend the paper.
candidates.shift: A shortcut in an abstract plan needs a physical-paper permit.
candidates.novelty: Geometry plus permission, not repeated signatures or waiting recursion.
candidates.limit: Physical metaphor cannot be followed as clinical or electrical procedure.

candidates.text: Because coincidence has been promoted to project manager.
candidates.shift: Coincidence receives causal responsibility by appointment.
candidates.novelty: Misattributed causation, not evidence arriving after its conclusion.
candidates.limit: Does not assert a real diagnosis or assign blame to the questioner.

candidates.text: Because cause and effect are sharing a password.
candidates.shift: Separate causal roles lose their identity through shared credentials.
candidates.novelty: Authentication transfer; no named technology or runtime substitution.
candidates.limit: Not actual credential advice; short but conceptual turn may need reader review.

candidates.text: Because the explanation is paid by the complication.
candidates.shift: Payment incentives manufacture unnecessary complexity.
candidates.novelty: Incentive structure rather than A4 theatrical overhead; related complexity motif acknowledged.
candidates.limit: Satirizes explanatory machinery, not a medical professional or distressed user.

candidates.text: The witness called by the alibi.
candidates.shift: An abstract defense calls its own witness.
candidates.novelty: Legal role reversal; no calendar, committee or fabricated real identity.
candidates.limit: An obviously impossible agent relation; factual identification intentionally not provided.

candidates.text: The expert appointed by a show of invisible hands.
candidates.shift: An appointment rests on votes nobody can observe.
candidates.novelty: Invisible voting, distinct from alibi agency.
candidates.limit: No actual expert, doctor, accused person or relief organization is named.

candidates.text: Choose whichever option would be most embarrassed to appear in its own advertisement.
candidates.shift: A sales pitch embarrasses the thing being sold.
candidates.novelty: Self-image against publicity, not vendor loyalty or an external animal judge.
candidates.limit: No named winner; the criterion requires impossible option emotions, not financial comparison.

candidates.text: Because the dictionary records the rules after the words have already broken them.
candidates.shift: Rule-breaking precedes the authority that records rules.
candidates.novelty: Lexicographic time reversal, not generic exception exemption.
candidates.limit: Dictionary is a fictional authority here, not a factual history of spelling or pronunciation.

candidates.text: This answer contains no useful information. Its confidence is sold separately.
candidates.shift: Confidence is an optional paid accessory to an empty product.
candidates.novelty: Commodity separation rather than fictional certification, proof of purchase or settled uncertainty.
candidates.limit: Explicitly useless answer; specific form degrades without pretending to offer advice.

candidates.text: The oracle is out of facts. It is polishing the delivery.
candidates.shift: The source of knowledge substitutes presentation for knowledge.
candidates.novelty: Presentation replacing substance, distinct from U01 accessory pricing.
candidates.limit: Target is the oracle; neither reassures about harm nor blames incomplete inputs.

rejected.text: The differences are pronounced. The agreement is silent.

rejected.text: When the clock finishes checking whether now is available.
